audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 read Skill although whys[3] and whys[4] both describe Maokai grinding him down, and row 6 reads Maokai while whys[6] and spikes[3] say 2+ items is Swain's window outright.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Maokai rows 1-5, and Maokai wins 61.29%. Row 6 is the one place the page's own prose insists on Swain — full-build soul stacks plus Demonic Ascension out-heal Maokai's chip.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Maokai, row 6 to Swain, as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and accurate: Maokai's 2-3 window, level 6 Nature's Grasp, the first-item sustain spike, Swain's 2+ item peak.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Nevermove treats it as a tether that roots where it lands. It roots on the RETURN pass.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits.' You are safe on the outbound and caught coming back, which changes when you step up. It is 12s at rank 1. Demonic Ascension (120s) also only persists while he keeps draining champions, so breaking contact ends it.
audit.corrected: Return-pass rule and both cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'Use Sapling Toss' in wants.you[2] as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: Sapling Toss is Maokai's real E name in the kit file — this is a false positive from the near-miss matcher, not an error.

edits.before: Build MR — anti-heal his drain, W-root him. Maokai wins the Demonic Ascension cooldown windows.
edits.after: Nevermove roots on the return pass, not on the way out — step clear behind it, then W-root him.

edits.before: His drain. Root when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Nevermove (12s) roots on its return sweep — move out after the outbound wave.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The return sweep is what roots — sidestep behind it, not in front.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain. Root when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Swain Nevermove (12s at rank 1): the root lands on the return pass, so move after the outbound wave. - Demonic Ascension (120s) lasts only while he drains champions — break contact. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: Row 6 was set to Swain rather than the packet's 'Skill' because whys[6], spikes[3] and the late block all state plainly that full-build Swain out-heals Maokai; leaving it Maokai contradicted the page's own text. All content prose here is first person ('My W root into Q') — a champion-wide voice pass is warranted for maokai.
